    Who We Are

    ISBU is the leading organization representing over 200 small and medium-sized Israeli vendors in cybersecurity and defense.


    We connect global companies with Israeli vendors offering cutting-edge technologies, fostering growth, collaboration, and market expansion.

    Our Vision : 

    Empowering Security. Enabeling Excellence.

     

    ISBU is a visionary company revolutionizing Defense and Security scouting through comprehensive, data-driven solutions. By partnering with top experts in Israel's defense industry and collaborating with cutting-edge start-ups, we deliver unparalleled excellence in Security, Defense, and Strategic Intelligence.

     

    Our mission is to harness the power of data and leverage the expertise of industry leaders to provide you with the utmost level of security, advanced defense technologies, and strategic insights. With ISBU, you can trust that you are equipped with the best-in-class solutions to safeguard your organization and stay ahead in an ever-evolving landscape of security challenges.

    Services for International Companies
    • Access 200+ Israeli cybersecurity and defense companies, leveraging cutting-edge technologies and expertise.
    • Connect with suitable Israeli companies for collaborations and partnerships.
    • Navigate the Israeli market with expert guidance on business landscape, regulations, and market trends.
    • Explore investment opportunities in Israeli companies, backed by thorough due diligence and negotiation support.

    • Explore growth and investment opportunities with ISBU.
